build_bert_bpe_encoder: build a python module that uses BertBPE to encode text into BPE tokens via the HuggingFace BertTokenizer
encode_text_with_bert_bpe: encode a string into BPE tokenized text using the BertBPE encode method
decode_bert_bpe_tokens: decode BPE tokenized text back into a cleaned string using the BertBPE decode method
check_bpe_token_word_boundary: check if a BPE token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
configure_bert_bpe_args: configure BertBPE with argparse arguments for cased mode and a custom vocab file path
